settings.question: How do I clean my Rano bag?
settings.answer: Wipe the leather with a soft, dry cloth. For marks, use a slightly damp cloth and let it air dry. Avoid detergents and solvents.

settings.question: Will the leather change over time?
settings.answer: Yes. Genuine leather softens and develops character with use. That is part of its charm.

settings.question: Can my bag get wet?
settings.answer: Light rain is fine. Pat it dry and keep it away from heaters or direct sunlight while drying.

settings.question: What are the dimensions of the Traveller?
settings.answer: See the product page for exact measurements. The Traveller is sized as a weekender and fits most overhead cabins.

settings.question: Is the leather genuine?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Rano piece is made from 100% genuine leather with silver-tone hardware.

settings.question: Will you restock sold-out colours?
settings.answer: Our drops are limited. Sign up for the newsletter to hear first about new releases.

settings.question: Do the pouch and card holder match the Traveller?
settings.answer: Yes. Each colour (Giallo, Rosa, Blue Mare) is available across the Traveller, Travel Pouch and Card Holder.

settings.question: Where are Rano bags designed?
settings.answer: Rano is designed in Casarano, a small town in southern Italy, and carried from Amsterdam.

settings.question: What makes Rano different?
settings.answer: Clean lines, carefully selected leather and finishing details that are made to last, not to follow seasons.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Yes, shipping is free on every order.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1-2 working days. Delivery usually takes 2-4 working days within Europe.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: You receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships. You can also check your order status in your account.

settings.question: Can I return my order?
settings.answer: Unused items can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Contact us to start a return.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Refunds are processed within 5 working days after we receive your return.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All major cards, iDEAL, PayPal, Apple Pay and Klarna, depending on your country.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. As long as your order has not shipped yet, we can change or cancel it.
